## Summary and validation

What changed, why, and how did you test it?

## Contribution type

- [ ] **Regular change** (code, tests, docs, UI or tooling). No dataset version, live run or revision sign-off needed. Admin review and merge to `main` completes this PR.
- [ ] **Dataset candidate** (including mixed code + data changes). Link `changesets/<version>/review.json` and `changes.md` below; include the live/replay run IDs, evidence, sign-offs and any outstanding findings. Coordinate the version with the admin. Merge does **not** publish.
- [ ] **Audit-only maintenance**. Link the decision/evidence and describe the scope; this does not by itself publish a dataset.

The checklist is for reviewers. CI selects checks from changed files, not these boxes. Only an administrator can dispatch a reviewed version for publication.
